text:
ajay-infra: Heads up — ap-southeast-1 GPU pool provisioning slowed down ~30s tonight. Saw a spike in KMS decryption latency around the same time. Suspect audit-sampling changes rolled earlier today.

linda-sre: yup saw the same. Autoscaler logs show control-plane API calls queuing up, then backoff. Warm pool nodes fail to attach for a bit.

maria-security: we did flip the audit sampler threshold for that region to 1% -> 10% for flowlogs retention testing. That should reduce storage, not increase KMS calls though. Did anything else change? @dave-platform

dave-platform: i deployed a tighter VPC egress ACL earlier (rule order tweak). Might be blocking some internal metrics endpoints used by the keystore-proxy.

ajay-infra: debug dump: 
```
2026-03-19T23:41:12Z autoscaler: attach_request id=abc123 status=pending
2026-03-19T23:41:13Z kms-proxy: decrypt start id=def456
2026-03-19T23:41:43Z kms-proxy: decrypt timeout err=timeout
```
Looks like decrypts are delayed ~30s before failing and backoff.

linda-sre: can we confirm if keystore-proxy is making extra KMS calls per attach because of audit sampling? maybe double-lookup path.

maria-security: audit-sampler only affects whether we copy flow logs to long-term bucket. It shouldn't change KMS calls. But our new sampler proxy emits an attest event for sampled requests and signs it (calls KMS). If sampler % up, calls up. Missed that interaction.

ajay-infra: ah — that matches: more sampled events -> more signing -> KMS saturation -> attach waits. Two issues then: latency SLO on KMS and VPC rule blocking metrics.

dave-platform: short-term mitigation: revert sampler back to previous % for ap-southeast-1 and relax egress ACL for keystore-proxy->kms endpoints (allow 443 to kms regional endpoints). Can do both in next 10m.

maria-security: +1 on revert. But this affects cost goals for the retention test. Suggest we instead route signing to a local HSM cache layer to avoid KMS per event. Longer-term.

linda-sre: agreed. Immediate plan: (1) relax ACL for keystore-proxy (2) rollback sampler % to 1% (3) bump KMS client's socket timeout/retry to avoid long backoffs so autoscaler doesn't block.

ajay-infra: PRs coming. I'll tag oncall. ops-bot: @oncall please escalate if nodes continue to fail attach after rollback.

ops-bot: Incident created #INC-2026-3185, page sent to oncall.

dave-platform: putting those changes behind a canary for the next 5 mins in ap-southeast-1, will monitor token usage and attach latency.

maria-security: logging note: we should add a metric for "signing-per-attach" so this interaction is visible in dashboards. Filing a follow-up after rollback.

linda-sre: if we see >50ms median decrypt latency we should consider shifting some control plane traffic to eu nodes as fallback for the region. That adds cost but keeps SLO.

ajay-infra: thanks team. rolling the revert now.
